steps.text: Every person grows through stages from birth to old age. Let's walk through them.
Tap a stage to explore it — start with “Adolescence”.
The order is: Infancy → Childhood → Adolescence (about 10–19 years) → Adulthood → Old age.
Adolescence is the stage between childhood and adulthood, when the body grows and changes the most. That's this chapter's focus.

coach.mission: Explore the stages of human life from infancy to old age.
whenStuck: Tap each stage to see what happens in it.
Try to put them in order from birth onward.
whenWrong: The order is infancy, childhood, adolescence, adulthood, then old age.
Adolescence comes between childhood and adulthood.
whenCorrect: Right — that's where that stage fits in the journey of growth.
Good — adolescence is the big-change stage between childhood and adulthood.
coach.done: You've seen the stages of human life. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
